content: {"summary":"Node search-cluster-02 ran out of /var space in November 2025 because the OpenSearch log file under /var/log/opensearch/ was not being rotated, grew about 1 GB per day and filled the root disk.","likely_cause":"Unrotated OpenSearch log file under /var/log/opensearch/ grew unchecked, exhausting /var space.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The OpenSearch log file was not rotated and grew unchecked","evidence_ids":["RB-008#1"],"quote":"One app log is huge and not rotated (`/var/log/opensearch/*.log`"},{"text":"No logrotate entry existed for OpenSearch","evidence_ids":["INC-0101#1"],"quote":"no OpenSearch entry in `/etc/logrotate.d/`."},{"text":"The log grew about 1 GB per day, filling the disk","evidence_ids":["INC-0101#1"],"quote":"The log grows about 1 GB a day."},{"text":"Restored missing logrotate config with copytruncate","evidence_ids":["INC-0101#1"],"quote":"put the logrotate file back from config management (with `copytruncate`"},{"text":"Forced rotation with logrotate to reclaim space","evidence_ids":["RB-008#1"],"quote":"run `sudo logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/<name>`"}]}
